in_sanskrit.name: Mofiz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है One who is wise and powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mofiz एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mofiz is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'mudhita', meaning 'wise'. It is also associated with the god Shiva, who is known for his immense wisdom and power. The name is a reminder that wisdom and power go hand in hand, and that those who possess both are truly blessed.
